question.text: A 3-bucket PMS portfolio (equity, debt, gold) with monthly threshold rebalancing of 5% will rebalance:

answer.text: At the monthly review, when any bucket/asset class is outside the 5% tolerance band

explanation.text: The Logic: The IPS should specify both the rebalancing periodicity and the tolerance band. Threshold rebalancing uses trigger points, so at the monthly review the manager checks the portfolio and rebalances any asset class that has breached the 5% tolerance band. The Trap: "Never" or "Daily" misread the rule — it is neither a no-action policy nor a continuous trigger; action is taken at the scheduled review when a breach exists. Note: Tolerance bands should be documented in the IPS so the execution rule is unambiguous.
